name: graph-load
description: Load-only performance capture for the canonical Graph surface. Opens /graph, waits for rendered React Flow nodes and edges, and records graph size without driving interaction input.

evaluate.expression: (async () => { const deadline = Date.now() + 45000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const nodes = document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length; const edges = document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__edge').length; if (nodes >= 250 && edges >= 200) return { nodes, edges }; await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250)); } const nodes = document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length; const edges = document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__edge').length; throw new Error(`graph-load: topology evidence too small; nodes=${nodes}, edges=${edges}`); })()

(() => { const nodes = document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length; const edges = document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__edge').length; performance.mark('bas.graph-load.ready'); window.localStorage.setItem('swarm-manager.perf.graph-load.size', JSON.stringify({ nodes, edges })); return { nodes, edges }; })()

metadata.label: Record rendered graph size for trace notes
